tasks.title: Bootstrap clean Rust/Next.js monorepo

tasks.title: Machine-checked registry pattern and anti-vacuous guards
tasks.outcome: Shared vocabularies ship as frozen data plus a published document plus conformance tests that fail on disagreement, and every structural guard is executed against a deliberately broken copy of what it guards.
required_tests: document and frozen data reconciled cell by cell
each guard rejects its known-bad input
removing a guard fails the guard self-test
new vocabulary value without a decision record fails
tasks.notes: A guard that silently stops checking reports success indefinitely. scripts/validate_specs.py --self-test demonstrates the rule on this bundle.

tasks.title: Conformance vectors and hostile vectors

manifest digest mismatch fails the build
each hostile vector produces its expected refusal
a vector set with no hostile case fails
tasks.notes: Two implementations agreeing with a document is not evidence of agreement.

tasks.title: Token-free proof enrollment
tasks.outcome: Nodes enrol by protocol-role proof and, per advertised model and context class, model-execution proof, receiving a renewable role credential with no operator token and no approval step.
required_tests: node enrols with no operator-issued token
eligibility is granted only to the exact challenged claim
unchallenged context class cannot be served
a replayed or hostile proof is refused
tasks.notes: A shared bootstrap token makes the token the credential; proof binds it to measured capability.

tasks.title: Outbound node control connection and heartbeat
tasks.outcome: Node maintains authenticated outbound control connection with registration, heartbeat and freshness expiration.

tasks.title: Full hardware/software/GPU discovery fingerprint

tasks.title: Live GPU/host telemetry collection

tasks.title: Immutable deployment manifest and node advertisement
tasks.outcome: Define deployment fingerprint and advertise resident/available deployments with exact model/runtime/profile versions.
required_tests: mutable alias cannot change immutable fingerprint

tasks.title: Publish a deployment context ceiling sized to the envelope
tasks.outcome: Deployment loads at the largest context its measured envelope safely permits and publishes that value as max_context_tokens in the immutable manifest and node advertisement.
required_tests: ceiling derived from envelope, not configuration
published ceiling matches the loaded runtime window
reduced window records its stated constraint
tasks.notes: Context size is derived, never an operator constant.

tasks.title: Capability precedence: declared, measured, persisted
tasks.outcome: Capability claims resolve declared then measured then persisted, keyed by deployment fingerprint, so a model that is not currently loaded remains admissible and cold start cannot deadlock.
required_tests: unloaded model admissible from declared claim
measured supersedes declared for the same fingerprint
new fingerprint falls back to declared
tasks.notes: An autoloading runtime reports no window for an unloaded model.

tasks.title: Record measured runtime tuning per deployment
tasks.outcome: Each qualified deployment records measured prefill and decode at depth, KV cache type, backend, thread count, device memory headroom, and drafter acceptance, as measurements rather than configuration intent.
required_tests: throughput record without a depth is rejected
drafter without a recorded acceptance rate is not qualified
backend change produces a new deployment fingerprint
MoE deployment with non-resident experts advertises as low-throughput
tasks.notes: Thread count set to SMT threads rather than physical cores cost 19x on one host.

tasks.title: Prompt ledger metadata and encrypted payload storage
tasks.outcome: Record encrypted prompt events idempotently behind a bounded sink-neutral buffer while preserving durable-ingest access-audit primitives.
required_tests: bounded loss is visible and never blocks gateway admission

tasks.title: Prompt ingest API and submission ordering
tasks.outcome: Gateway derives prompt_id/hash before routing, offers the encrypted record without waiting for storage, and keeps the explicit durable-ingest API fail-closed.
required_tests: unavailable or blocked sink does not delay or refuse gateway admission
bounded buffer overflow is measured and does not backpressure admission
explicit durable ingest still fails without committed submission

tasks.title: Read-side ledger integrity
tasks.outcome: Every read of an ordered record proves the whole record gapless rather than the returned page, with storage-engine premises asserted against the live engine.
required_tests: gap below the reader cursor is detected
page-shaped check alone fails the suite
engine rejects the write that would violate each premise
no second journal implementation is introduced
tasks.notes: A correct writer is not the same thing as a trustworthy reader.

tasks.title: Gateway registry and `/v1/models`
tasks.outcome: Gateway maintains fresh node/deployment catalog and exposes OpenAI-compatible model listing.

tasks.title: OpenAI streaming ingress against deterministic backend
tasks.outcome: Implement streaming chat/completion ingress with request IDs, cancellation plumbing and deterministic mock backend.

tasks.title: Seat/session/context/KV capacity model
tasks.outcome: Model active sessions as unequal seats with context/KV/output reserve and shared model weight accounting.

tasks.title: Enforce the context ceiling as a hard admission bound
tasks.outcome: Admission refuses any request whose total or predicted peak context exceeds the deployment ceiling, before capacity arithmetic, returning a non-retryable 413 CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED naming the actual ceiling.
tasks.notes: Free capacity never raises a ceiling.

tasks.title: Reservation liveness and stale reclamation
tasks.outcome: Reservations carry progress timestamps and are reclaimed on silence rather than duration, with idempotent release and recorded reclaim events.
required_tests: leaked reservation reclaimed after the silence bound
long request making progress is never reclaimed
tasks.notes: Measuring duration instead of silence kills long legitimate requests.

tasks.title: Node authoritative admission and leases
tasks.outcome: Gateway prediction is confirmed by authoritative node lease/admission with bounded expiration/cancellation.

tasks.title: Single-source queue observability
tasks.outcome: Queue position and estimated wait are served from the structure that orders admission, so every waiter is visible to API and dashboard alike.
required_tests: waiting requests appear while they wait
absent estimate reported as absent, never zero
tasks.notes: Recording only executing work reports an empty queue to waiting clients.

tasks.title: Node serviceability gate and shipped default policy
tasks.outcome: A node becomes schedulable only after a real request traverses its full authorization and admission path, and every fail-closed gate ships a working default policy with its installer.
required_tests: fresh install serves a real request end to end
missing policy fails the install, not the first user
liveness probe alone does not satisfy the gate
tasks.notes: A fail-closed gate with no policy refuses everything while reporting healthy.

tasks.title: Routing hard constraints
tasks.outcome: Filter candidates by exact model/capability/context/resource/privacy/license/policy constraints.

tasks.title: Context-size alias semantics
tasks.outcome: Context-size aliases resolve as request-shaping hints against one deployment rather than as separate qualified deployments, and never widen a ceiling.
required_tests: alias family resolves to a single deployment
alias below the ceiling is honoured as intent
alias above the ceiling is refused, not downgraded
tasks.notes: Separate deployments per size reintroduce the fixed tiers invariant 4 forbids.

tasks.title: Best-fit capacity placement
tasks.outcome: Choose lowest sufficient context/KV headroom after hard filtering to preserve large capacity.

tasks.title: Sticky sessions and cache affinity

tasks.title: Bounded rescue ladder and automatic profile rollback

tasks.title: Discovered device inventory and requalification on change

device change creates a new host generation
context ceiling re-derived for the new generation
no silent CPU fallback on missing devices

a colour outside the token source fails

tasks.title: Per-GPU claims, per-model dwell and availability floor in the autoscaler
tasks.outcome: The autoscaler claims individual GPUs, rebalances one GPU per decision, holds each GPU for its model's dwell (configured, or max(300 s, 10 x measured p95 load)), never chooses a donor that would breach a model's healthy-instance floor or whose load cost is unmeasured, and persists loaded_at and swap intent on the claim.
required_tests: GPU inside dwell is never a donor and restart cannot shorten dwell
model without measured load time is never a donor
property: no decision sequence breaches an availability floor
model at floor is freed only after another instance is healthy
GpuDwell, AvailabilityFloor and UnmeasuredLoadCost holds carry their numbers

tasks.title: Node GPU swap executor: drain, pinned load, rollback
tasks.outcome: A node executes a GPU swap from persisted intent: drain with a bounded per-model deadline and INSTANCE_DRAINED cancellation, unload, load with every runtime component pinned to the claimed GPU and verified from device memory accounting, warm through the real admission path, and roll back or quarantine on failure, with runtime on-demand loading and eviction disabled.
required_tests: request within drain deadline completes before unload
request past drain deadline receives retryable 503 INSTANCE_DRAINED
failed load rolls back to the previous deployment and records a start failure
OOM on load is classified and not retried into the same placement
executor killed during STARTING resumes from persisted intent
weights, drafter and projector allocated on the claimed GPU
request for an unloaded model is refused and evicts nothing

tasks.title: GPU hot-swap conformance and live-load swap evidence

required_tests: live swap under load keeps every model at or above its floor at every sample
every swap decision and phase event is recorded with swap ID
measured load duration updates p95 used for derived dwell

tasks.title: Topology graph model and local gateway export

tasks.title: Federated topology composition

composition over a cyclic graph terminates and marks the cycle
conflicting exports resolve by version, not arrival order
composed graph exposes no single network-wide timestamp

aggregate vertices are distinguishable from leaves by type

totals are shown with the uncertainty they were computed over
renderer consumes only the published contract

tasks.title: Inter-gateway capacity request protocol
tasks.outcome: A gateway can ask a peer for capacity on the control plane without holding the triggering client request: negotiation runs on its own clock, a peer answers or refuses immediately with a spec 06 reason code, and no peer offers capacity it has already granted elsewhere.
required_tests: client request is not held beyond the spec 06 admission budget while a peer is asked
a peer with outstanding grants does not offer the same capacity twice
refusal is immediate and carries a reason code

tasks.title: Standby slot grants and lifecycle

required_tests: standby offered never exceeds the measured envelope
expiry is evaluated on time since last progress, not elapsed time
revocation honours the stated notice and returns slots to the envelope
routing to an expired grant is rejected

tasks.title: Capacity request loop and amplification control
tasks.outcome: Capacity requests carry a path vector and hop budget and are bounded by a configured fan-out breadth, so one shortage cannot broadcast across a mesh and a malformed path causes refusal rather than an unbounded walk.
required_tests: a request whose path already contains the receiver is refused
a request at hop budget zero is answered or refused, never forwarded
fan-out never exceeds the configured breadth
a malformed path vector causes refusal, not traversal

tasks.title: Capacity grant receipts and forecast signals
tasks.outcome: Every grant, refusal, revocation and expiry is a receipt carrying path vector, hop budget, envelope offered and accounting lineage, and held/revoked grants feed pre-staging so a site meeting demand by borrowing is visible rather than hidden.
required_tests: each grant, refusal, revocation and expiry emits a receipt
receipts carry lineage so one served request bills exactly once
repeated revocation surfaces as an under-provisioning signal

tasks.title: Core protocol data model: canonical identity, artifacts, capabilities, resources, provenance
tasks.outcome: Nodes, runtimes and gateways advertise a canonical model identity, artifact identity, capabilities with extensible properties, resource requirements with topology, serving profiles, runtime engine metadata and provenance, where unknown metadata stays explicitly unknown and never forces a missing field into a guessed value.

unknown capability IDs and model types are preserved and forwarded
capability properties are capability-specific and extensible
artifact quantization/precision values are preserved without assuming one framework

tasks.title: Core protocol capacity and lifecycle events
tasks.outcome: Runtimes and deployments advertise timestamped slot/capacity, residency, cold-start, pending capacity and capacity confidence, and emit generic lifecycle, eviction, recovery, scale, rebalance and node-loss events with standard reason codes mapped from infrastructure without exposing the scheduler as a required abstraction.
required_tests: capacity advertisements are timestamped and change independently of model identity
model residency distinguishes a free slot on a loaded model from a required download
lifecycle and eviction events carry standard reason codes with scheduler mapping
recovery event sequence lets upstream compute recovery time without guessing
pending capacity never fabricates an ETA when the scheduler cannot provide one
health probes are classified and do not count as user demand

tasks.title: Core protocol metric system and benchmark interchange
tasks.outcome: Performance, quality, reliability and resource-usage telemetry is transported as extensible metric definitions and structured samples with provenance, windows, distributions and counters, and benchmark results use a standard interchange format attributable to the actual artifact and runtime.

metric samples carry source type, producer and confidence
percentiles (P50/P90/P95/P99) and counters with reset semantics are representable

quality evidence transports metrics without a universal intelligence score
self-reported and observed values coexist without overwriting each other

tasks.title: Core protocol federation provenance and reconciliation
tasks.outcome: Federated advertisements retain origin gateway/node, trust level and freshness, preserve independent remote deployments instead of collapsing by model_id, mark disconnected capacity stale rather than live, and reconcile on reconnect without duplicate runtime identity or duplicate event replay.

a remote gateway advertising only model/capabilities/slots participates without artifact or hardware
disconnected capacity becomes stale/unavailable and is not advertised live
reconnect reconciles state without duplicate runtime identities or duplicate events
trust is never auto-promoted by passing through a trusted gateway

tasks.title: Core protocol routing, fallback and error semantics
tasks.outcome: Schedulers and gateways match capability contracts and hard requirements, evaluate resource compatibility, cold-start and reliability signals, resolve aliases and advisory fallbacks, and return structured errors with retryability, while preserving existing OpenAI-compatible behavior and request classification.

structured routing reasons and error taxonomy/retryability are transmitted
older gateways advertising only model/endpoint/slots keep functioning

tasks.title: Core protocol conformance and scheduler-agnostic tests
